title: he-soc — Centralized Performance Monitoring on a PULP-based SoC (EMSOFT 2026 artifact)
description: Artifact for the EMSOFT 2026 paper 'A Centralized Performance Monitoring Architecture for Heterogeneous Multicore SoCs.' A PULP-based quad-core CVA6 SoC extended with the Advanced Performance Monitoring Unit (APMU), per-core Event Monitoring Units (EVUs), and AXI-SPUs. The IPs we author are released under the Solderpad Hardware License v0.51 (treatable, at the licensee's option, as Apache-2.0); upstream components (CVA6, lowRISC Ibex, AlSaqr, PULP) retain their original open-source licenses. Active development continues at https://github.com/Rodolfo-Pellizzoni-Lab/he-soc
